method: Independent specification, component split and flat inclusive transition definitions; explore reachable split/audit product and check exact local labeled correspondence at every state. Independently calibrate compact wire audit against unchanged M1B oracle.
sequence: Prospective admission and source snapshots before local execution
Retain all failed, limited and successful attempts; repair only in new commits
Synthesize bounded results into canonical claims without full-freeze promotion
Two complete gates on identical clean candidate and two independent exact-commit reviews
Normal push to separate review branch; retain final attestations outside candidate
source_fact_boundary: Eviction means a modeled source retention loss and removal of its sole candidate copy. It is not inferred from a notification gap. Snapshot availability is a separately enabled modeled fact, not authenticated storage evidence.
current_recovery: WELCOME advances the literal audit cursor before RESET installs the snapshot in application state. Reset requires the exact next uncovered loss and available matching snapshot; future candidates remain owned. Historical requires_reset remains true after accepted recovery.
stop_boundary: Logical independent Stop request/application, with named weak fairness for application. No physical process termination, task completion or eventual producer delivery theorem.
unimplemented: Actual emitted-exhaustion recovery in normal-source product (retained literal audit controls only)
Authenticated replay store, persistent snapshots and crash recovery
Control transport delivery/loss and physical Stop
Full six obligations and 27-row corpus beyond partial 01/02/26; optional22 remains unselected
Unbounded sources, identities, loss episodes, dynamic queue configurations and real provider consumption
capacity_policy: Monitor live account; no manual reset or new metered spend. No new workers at <=6% remaining, checkpoint at <=3%; stop new construction on automatic reset, cutoff or exploration limit.
publication: Normal review-branch push only after exact candidate gates/reviews; no default merge, force push or operational machinery.
